sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
In Scary Face Match, the core gameplay mechanics are straightforward: match three or more scary faces in a row or column to earn rewards and progress through levels. The game features a variety of face types, each with its own point value and special abilities. The objective is to create as many matches as possible within the time limit, while avoiding obstacles and dealing with power-ups that can either help or hinder your progress.

The game starts with a tutorial level that introduces you to the basic gameplay mechanics. As you progress through the levels, the difficulty increases, and you'll encounter new face types, obstacles, and power-ups that will challenge your skills and strategy. The game also features a variety of modes, including a time attack mode where you'll have to complete levels as quickly as possible, and a puzzle mode where you'll have to solve a series of puzzles within a set time limit.

One of the key features of Scary Face Match is its scoring system. As you match faces, you'll earn points based on the number of faces in the match and the type of face being matched. The points are then used to unlock new levels, characters, and power-ups, which can help you progress through the game.

The game also features a number of power-ups and special abilities that can be used to aid or hinder your progress. These include a 'swap' power-up that allows you to swap two faces, a 'clear' power-up that removes a set number of faces, and a 'freeze' power-up that temporarily stops the game clock. You'll also encounter special faces that have unique abilities, such as a face that can destroy a set number of other faces or a face that can swap two faces.

As you progress through the game, you'll also encounter a variety of obstacles that will challenge your skills and strategy. These include blocks that cannot be matched, obstacles that will destroy faces if not removed quickly, and power-ups that can either help or hinder your progress.
